title: Talbina
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add broken barley and wash with water.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein broken jau dal dein aur pani sad ho lein.

steps.instruction: Add water and soak for 3-4 hours or overnight then drain the water.
steps.romanUrdu: Pani dal dein aur 3-4 hours ya overnight k liya soak kerlein phir drain ker lein.

steps.instruction: In pot,add milk and bring it to boil,add soaked barley and mix well,cover partially and cook on low for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein doodh dal ker ubal lein, soaked jau dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur partially dhak ker 8-10 minutes k liya paka lein.
Khajore ka beech nikal ker chop kerlein.

steps.instruction: Add dates,mixwell,cover partially and cook on low flame for 25-30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Khajore dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur partially dhak ker halki ancch per 25-30 minutes k liya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add cardamom powder and mix well,cover partially and cook for another for 8-10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Elaichi powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur partially dhak ker 8-10 minutes k liya paka lein.
Pista aur badam dal ker ache tarhan mix kerlein.
